description:
Returns the platform business rules: the real consequences of actions that modify, delete or move resources (e.g., removing a video from a funnel deletes it permanently, it does not just unlink it).
Useful before planning such actions, so the advice given to the user matches how the platform actually behaves.
Domains: funnels, videos_and_folders, playlists, drm_watermark, comparisons_ab_tests, lives, shorts, player_profiles, anti_download_and_domains, credits, thumbnails_and_subtitles.

domain.description: Filter by domain (e.g. 'funnels', 'playlists', 'drm_watermark'). Omit to get ALL rules.

name: panda_get_business_rules
title: Get Business Rules
